title: Angels Landing, 1924: no chains, no switchbacks #Shorts
description:
In 1924 there were no chains and no Walter's Wiggles on the way up Angels Landing. A newspaper said the ridge narrowed from ten feet to ten inches. 

Video: the channel's own footage from Zion (2021). Photos: NPS, HABS/HAER, NARA (Beaman/Hillers) and Wikimedia Commons (public domain, CC0).

▶ Full Zion documentary: https://youtu.be/ugASzW14E9s
